```{r library}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(anndata)

library(reticulate)
```

```{r basic-setting}
setwd("/gscratch/kawaldorflab/tykim/R_files/Lung_atlas")
set.seed(42)

gradient <- c("blue", "white", "red")
```

```{r Load-RDS}
lung <- readRDS("/mmfs1/gscratch/kawaldorflab/tykim/R_files/Lung_atlas/lung_final.RDS")
```

```{r Normalize}
DefaultAssay(lung) <- "RNA"
lung <- NormalizeData(lung, assay = "RNA")
Idents(lung) <- "cell_type_final"
```

```{r Add-NHP-Number}
nhp_map <- c(Z16180np = "NHP1", Z21174np = "NHP2", Z22003np = "NHP3",
             Z17134np = "NHP4", Z14378np = "NHP5")
lung$sample_id <- factor(unname(nhp_map[sub("^CTRL_(.*)_lung_ZS_run[0-9]+$", "\\1", lung$sample)]),
                         levels = paste0("NHP", 1:5))

lung <- FindVariableFeatures(lung, nfeatures = 4000)
lung <- ScaleData(lung)
lung <- RunPCA(lung, npcs = 50, reduction.name = "pca_pre")
lung <- RunUMAP(lung, reduction = "pca_pre", dims = 1:50, reduction.name = "umap_pre")
lung[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
```

```{r QC-UMAP}
p1 <- DimPlot(lung, reduction = "umap_pre", group.by = "sample_id", shuffle = TRUE,
              pt.size = 0.1, raster = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Before integration", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")
p2 <- DimPlot(lung, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample_id", shuffle = TRUE,
              pt.size = 0.1, raster = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "After scANVI", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")

p_umap <- (p1 | p2) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) &
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"))
p_umap
ggsave("FINAL_FIGURES/integration_umap.pdf", plot = p_umap, width = 18, height = 8)
```

```{r Sample-mixing}
mix_score <- function(emb, sample) {
  nn <- FindNeighbors(emb, k.param = 31, return.neighbor = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
  idx <- Indices(nn)[, -1]
  lab <- matrix(as.integer(factor(sample))[idx], nrow = nrow(idx))
  p2 <- sapply(seq_len(nlevels(factor(sample))), function(k) rowMeans(lab == k)^2)
  1 / rowSums(p2)
}

ad0  <- read_h5ad("/mmfs1/gscratch/kawaldorflab/tykim/R_files/Lung_atlas/scanvi_output_v2.h5ad", backed = "r")
emb0 <- ad0$obsm[["X_scanvi"]]
rownames(emb0) <- as.character(ad0$obs_names$to_numpy())
stopifnot(all(colnames(lung) %in% rownames(emb0)))
lung[["scanvi_int"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = emb0[colnames(lung), ],
                                             key = "scANVIint_", assay = "RNA")
rm(ad0, emb0)

lung$mix_pre <- mix_score(Embeddings(lung, "pca_pre"), lung$sample_id)
lung$mix_scanvi <- mix_score(Embeddings(lung, "scanvi_int"), lung$sample_id)
c(before = median(lung$mix_pre), after = median(lung$mix_scanvi))
```

```{r QC-Violin}
mix_df <- data.frame(
  stage = factor(rep(c("Before integration", "After scANVI"), each = ncol(lung)),
                 levels = c("Before integration", "After scANVI")),
  score = c(lung$mix_pre, lung$mix_scanvi)
)

p_mix <- ggplot(mix_df, aes(stage, score, fill = stage)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "text", aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", after_stat(y))),
               vjust = -0.8, size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before integration" = "#E07B67", "After scANVI" = "#7BAAD0")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Sample mixing\n(inverse Simpson, 30 NN)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) +
  NoLegend()
p_mix
ggsave("FINAL_FIGURES/integration_mixing.pdf", plot = p_mix, width = 8, height = 8)
```


```{r Stacked-QC-Plot}
qc_features <- c(nFeature_RNA = "RNA Features (count)",
                 nCount_RNA = "RNA Counts",
                 pct_counts_mt = "Mitochondrial Counts (percent)")

qc_plots <- lapply(names(qc_features), function(f) {
  VlnPlot(lung,
          features = f,
          group.by = "cell_type_final",
          pt.size = 0,
          cols = DiscretePalette_scCustomize(
              num_colors = length(unique(lung$cell_type_final)),
              palette = "ditto_seq"
              )
          ) +
    NoLegend() +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = qc_features[[f]]) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 20))
})

qc_plots[1:2] <- lapply(qc_plots[1:2], function(p) {
  p + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
})

qc_stacked <- wrap_plots(qc_plots, ncol = 1)
qc_stacked
ggsave("FINAL_FIGURES/qc_violin_stack.pdf", plot = qc_stacked, width = 20, height = 16)
```

```{r Main-UMAP}
cent <- aggregate(Embeddings(lung, "umap")[, 1:2], by = list(ct = lung$cell_type_final), FUN = median)
colnames(cent) <- c("ct", "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

p_main <- DimPlot(lung,
                  reduction = "umap",
                  group.by = "cell_type_final",
                  cols = DiscretePalette_scCustomize(
                      num_colors = length(unique(lung$cell_type_final)),
                      palette = "ditto_seq"
                      ),
                  label = FALSE,
                  raster = FALSE,
                  pt.size = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = cent, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, label = ct), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  size = 7, color = "black",
                  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.18,
                  box.padding = 0.35, max.overlaps = Inf,
                  segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.3, seed = 42) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  ggtitle(NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20), legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"))
p_main
ggsave("FINAL_FIGURES/main_umap.pdf", plot = p_main, width = 16, height = 12)
```

```{r Tconv-Dotplot}
  `Tn` = c("CCR7", "SELL", "LEF1"),
  `CD4+Tem` = c("CD40LG", "DPP4", "S100A4", "IL32", "LGALS1", "ITGB1", "CD29", "ZNF683"),
  `CD4+Treg` = c("IL2RA", "CTLA4", "TIGIT", "IKZF2", "FOXP3"),
  `CD8+Tem` = c("GZMK", "GZMA"),
  `CD8+Tcyto` = c("ZEB2", "CX3CR1", "GZMB", "ENSMMUG00000063583"),
  `Lineage` = c("CD3E", "CD4", "CD8A", "ENSMMUG00000003532", "CD69", "NCAM1")
)
tconv_markers <- lapply(tconv_markers, intersect, rownames(lung))

p_tconv <- DotPlot_scCustom(lung,
                            features = unlist(tconv_markers, use.names = FALSE),
                            group.by = "cell_type_final",
                            remove_axis_titles = FALSE,
                            flip_axes = TRUE,
                            x_lab_rotate = TRUE,
                            colors_use = gradient) +
  labs(x = "Gene", y = "Cluster")

  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("MKI67+T/NK", "Tn", "CD4+Tem", "CD4+Treg", "CD8+Tem", "CD8+Tcyto"),
                   expand = expansion(add = 0.4)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cumsum(lengths(tconv_markers))[-length(tconv_markers)] + 0.5,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = "Percent\nExpressed", order = 2),
```

```{r Subcluster-UMAP}
atlas_cols <- setNames(
  DiscretePalette_scCustomize(num_colors = nlevels(lung$cell_type_final), palette = "ditto_seq"),
  levels(lung$cell_type_final)
)

compartments <- list(
  `lymphoid` = c("Tn", "CD4+Tem", "CD4+Treg", "CD8+Tem", "CD8+Tcyto", "MAIT-like", "Tinn",
                 "gdT", "ILC3", "NK", "MKI67+T/NK"),
  `b_cell` = c("Bn", "Bmem", "Plasma Cell"),
  `myeloid` = c("NEUT", "cMono", "ncMono", "Mo-IM", "IM", "AM", "MKI67+AM",
                 "cDC1", "cDC2", "DCmig", "pDC", "Mast"),
  `epi_mes` = c("AT1", "AT2", "pre-TB-SC", "Club", "MCC", "FIB", "Mural", "MESO"),
  `endo` = c("CAP1", "CAP2", "LEC")
)
stopifnot(all(unlist(compartments) %in% levels(lung$cell_type_final)))

compartment_umap <- function(types, name) {
  sub <- subset(lung, cells = colnames(lung)[lung$cell_type_final %in% types])
  sub$cell_type_final <- droplevels(sub$cell_type_final)
  sub <- RunUMAP(sub, reduction = "scanvi", dims = 1:30, n.neighbors = 30,
                 reduction.name = "umap_sub", reduction.key = "UMAPsub_", verbose = FALSE)

  cent <- aggregate(Embeddings(sub, "umap_sub")[, 1:2], by = list(ct = sub$cell_type_final), FUN = median)
  colnames(cent) <- c("ct", "UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

  p <- DimPlot(sub,
               reduction = "umap_sub",
               group.by = "cell_type_final",
               cols = atlas_cols[levels(sub$cell_type_final)],
               label = FALSE,
               raster = FALSE,
               pt.size = 0.3) +
    geom_text_repel(data = cent, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, label = ct), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                    size = 5, color = "black",
                    bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.18,
                    box.padding = 0.35, max.overlaps = Inf,
                    segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.3, seed = 42) +
    labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14), legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
          axis.line  = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40"))
  ggsave(paste0("FINAL_FIGURES/sub_umap_", name, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 5, height = 5)
  p
}

for (nm in names(compartments)) print(compartment_umap(compartments[[nm]], nm))
```

```{r Human-Ref}
hlca_heatmap <- function(level, min_prop = 0.05, file = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL) {
  lab <- sub("^[0-9]_", "", lung@meta.data[[paste0("hlca_l", level)]])
  ct <- droplevels(lung$cell_type_final)
  prop <- as.matrix(prop.table(table(ct, lab), 1))
  prop <- prop[, apply(prop, 2, max) >= min_prop, drop = FALSE]
  prop <- prop[, order(apply(prop, 2, which.max), -apply(prop, 2, max)), drop = FALSE]
  unc <- as.numeric(tapply(lung@meta.data[[paste0("hlca_l", level, "_uncert")]], ct, median)[rownames(prop)])

  ht <- Heatmap(prop, name = "Fraction\nof cells\n",
                col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#FC8D59", "#B30000")),
                cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
                row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 34),
                column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 34),
                column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(prop), gp = gpar(fontsize = 34)),
                row_title = "Pigtail Macaque Cell Type",
                row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 52),
                column_title = "\nHuman Cell Type\n", column_title_side = "bottom",
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 52),
                rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90", lwd = 0.5),
                heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32),
                                            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32),
                                            legend_height = unit(5, "cm"),
                                            grid_width = unit(0.8, "cm")),
                cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
                  if (prop[i, j] >= 0.1)
                    grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", 100 * prop[i, j]), x, y,
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 28,
                                        col = ifelse(prop[i, j] >= 0.6, "white", "black")))
                },
                right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                  `Median\nuncertainty` = anno_barplot(unc, ylim = c(0, 1), width = unit(7, "cm"),
                                                       bar_width = 0.8,
                                                       gp = gpar(fill = "grey40", col = NA),
                                                       axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 24))),
                  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32)))

  if (is.null(width))  width  <- 8 + 1.0 * ncol(prop)
  if (is.null(height)) height <- 10 + 0.6 * nrow(prop)
  main_title <- paste0("HLCA level ", level)
  title_gp <- gpar(fontsize = 32)
  if (!is.null(file)) {
    pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    draw(ht, column_title = main_title, column_title_gp = title_gp)
    dev.off()
  }
  draw(ht, column_title = main_title, column_title_gp = title_gp)
}

for (lev in 1:5) {
  hlca_heatmap(lev, file = paste0("FINAL_FIGURES/HLCA_heatmap_level", lev, ".pdf"))
}
```

```{r Rhesus-Ref-Cell}
rira_heatmap <- function(col, rows = NULL, min_prop = 0.05, file = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL, title = NULL) {
  keep_cells <- !is.na(lung@meta.data[[col]]) & lung@meta.data[[col]] != "not T/NK"
  if (!is.null(rows)) keep_cells <- keep_cells & lung$cell_type_final %in% rows
  lab <- lung@meta.data[[col]][keep_cells]
  ct <- droplevels(lung$cell_type_final[keep_cells])
  prop <- as.matrix(prop.table(table(ct, lab), 1))
  prop <- prop[, apply(prop, 2, max) >= min_prop, drop = FALSE]
  prop <- prop[, order(apply(prop, 2, which.max), -apply(prop, 2, max)), drop = FALSE]
  unc <- as.numeric(tapply(1 - lung@meta.data[[paste0(col, "_score")]][keep_cells], ct, median)[rownames(prop)])

  ht <- Heatmap(prop, name = "Fraction\nof cells\n",
                col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#74C476", "#00441B")),
                cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
                row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 38),
                column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 38),
                column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(prop), gp = gpar(fontsize = 32)),
                row_title = "Pigtail Macaque Cell Type\n",
                row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 48),
                column_title = "\nRhesus (RIRA) Cell Type\n", column_title_side = "bottom",
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 48),
                rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90", lwd = 0.5),
                heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32),
                                            labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32),
                                            legend_height = unit(5, "cm"),
                                            grid_width = unit(0.8, "cm")),
                cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
                  if (prop[i, j] >= 0.1)
                    grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", 100 * prop[i, j]), x, y,
                              gp = gpar(fontsize = 28,
                                        col = ifelse(prop[i, j] >= 0.6, "white", "black")))
                },
                right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                  bar = anno_barplot(unc, ylim = c(0, 1), width = unit(3, "cm"),
                                     gp = gpar(fill = "grey40", col = NA),
                                     axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 16))),
                  annotation_label = "Median\nuncertainty",
                  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 32)))

  if (is.null(width))  width  <- 8 + 1.0 * ncol(prop)
  if (is.null(height)) height <- 10 + 0.6 * nrow(prop)
  title_gp <- gpar(fontsize = 32)
  if (!is.null(file)) {
    pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
    draw(ht, column_title = title, column_title_gp = title_gp)
    dev.off()
  }
  draw(ht, column_title = title, column_title_gp = title_gp)
}

rira_heatmap("rira_fine", file = "FINAL_FIGURES/RIRA_heatmap_celltype.pdf", title = "RIRA cell type")
```

```{r Rhesus-Ref-Eff}
effector_rows <- setdiff(levels(lung$cell_type_final), c("Bmem", "cDC1", "cDC2", "ILC3", "IM", "Mo-IM", "Mast", "ncMono"))

keep_cells <- !is.na(lung$rira_effector) & lung$rira_effector != "not T/NK" &
              lung$cell_type_final %in% effector_rows
eff_lab <- lung$rira_effector[keep_cells]
eff_ct <- droplevels(lung$cell_type_final[keep_cells])
eff_prop <- as.matrix(prop.table(table(eff_ct, eff_lab), 1))
eff_prop <- eff_prop[, apply(eff_prop, 2, max) >= 0.05, drop = FALSE]
eff_prop <- eff_prop[, order(apply(eff_prop, 2, which.max), -apply(eff_prop, 2, max)), drop = FALSE]
eff_unc <- as.numeric(tapply(1 - lung$rira_effector_score[keep_cells], eff_ct, median)[rownames(eff_prop)])

ht_eff <- Heatmap(eff_prop, name = "Fraction\nof cells\n",
                  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#74C476", "#00441B")),
                  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
                  row_names_side = "left", column_names_rot = 45,
                  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
                  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
                  row_title = "Pigtail Macaque Cell Type",
                  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 22),
                  column_title = "Rhesus (RIRA) Cell Type", column_title_side = "bottom",
                  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 22),
                  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90", lwd = 0.5),
                  heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
                                              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13),
                                              legend_height = unit(3.5, "cm"),
                                              grid_width = unit(0.5, "cm")),
                  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
                    if (eff_prop[i, j] >= 0.1)
                      grid.text(sprintf("%.0f", 100 * eff_prop[i, j]), x, y,
                                gp = gpar(fontsize = 10,
                                          col = ifelse(eff_prop[i, j] >= 0.6, "white", "black")))
                  },
                  right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                    bar = anno_barplot(eff_unc, ylim = c(0, 1), width = unit(1, "cm"),
                                       gp = gpar(fill = "grey40", col = NA),
                                       axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))),
                    annotation_label = "Median\nuncertainty",
                    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13)))

eff_title_gp <- gpar(fontsize = 15)
pdf("FINAL_FIGURES/RIRA_heatmap_effector.pdf",
    width = 5 + 0.3 * ncol(eff_prop), height = 4.5 + 0.3 * nrow(eff_prop))
draw(ht_eff, column_title = "RIRA effector phenotype", column_title_gp = eff_title_gp)
dev.off()
draw(ht_eff, column_title = "RIRA effector phenotype", column_title_gp = eff_title_gp)
```
